newsitem.title: BELGIUM: French ActivCard shareholders approve bond issue.
newsitem.headline: French ActivCard shareholders approve bond issue.

text.p: The annual meeting of shareholders in French "smart card" maker ActivCard has approved a company proposal to issue convertible bonds, through a private placement, to raise up to $15 million, ActivCard said in a statement on Friday.
The meeting took place on June 17.
Easdaq-listed ActivCard said the funds would be used to finance the growth of the company.
The brokers of the issue are Bryan Garnier & Co in London and New York-based Cross Border Enterprises.
ActivCard chairman Jean Gerard Galvez told the meeting the company had made good sales progress over the year.
"As sales of our products continues to grow worldwide and with the additional expansion plans we have for the U.S., ActivCard will continue to make good progress," he said.

Shareholders also re-elected for another one-year term all five directors standing for re-election and approved the appointement of Phillippe Delmas to the board as a new non-executive director. Delams is senior vice president of French industrial group Lagardere Group.
